header: Using an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline with Amazon S3
content:
With OpenSearch Ingestion, you can use Amazon S3 as a source or as a destination. When you
use Amazon S3 as a source, you send data to an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline. When you use
Amazon S3 as a destination, you write data from an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline to one or more
S3 buckets.
